effect.shortEffect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.
effect.full: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

english.ch: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

japanese.ch: 接触技を使う時 相手の守りの効果を無視して 本来の1/4のダメージを与える。 相手の守りの効果以外は発動される。
